fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the use of grep to identify information about the operating system architecture. Often combined beforehand with the execution of "uname" or "cat /proc/cpuinfo"
fields.name: OS Architecture Discovery Via Grep
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="linux" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "/grep" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains "aarch64" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "arm" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "i386" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "i686" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "mips" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "x86_64")))
